# Bed Wars — visual language

Last updated: 2026-07-20

## Sprite style (all art generated by `mod/tools/make-sprites.ps1`)

- Flat pixel art, **no anti-aliasing** (SmoothingMode None), transparent bg,
  2px dark outline `#1a1a1a` at ~70% alpha around every shape.
- Palette: wood `#6b4a2b` / dark wood `#55381f`, mattress `#e8e4da`,
  **west blue `#3d6fd6`**, **east red `#d64040`**, obsidian `#3a3f4a` +
  plinth `#2a2e36`, teal glow `#58e0d0` / `#a8f0e8`, gold `#c9a227`,
  upgrade purple `#8a4ad6`, canvas white `#f0f0f0`, thumbnail bg `#22262e`.
- Regenerate art by editing the script and re-running it — never hand-edit PNGs.

## Team identity (never swap these)

| Team | Color (GUI/chat/map) | Bed sprite |
| --- | --- | --- |
| West | `{r=0.2, g=0.5, b=1}` | blue blanket |
| East | `{r=1, g=0.25, b=0.25}` | red blanket |

## In-game GUI conventions

- Lobby + victory screens live in `gui.center`; HUD is one horizontal frame in
  `gui.top` named `bw_hud`. All element names are prefixed `bw_`.
- Primary action buttons use style `confirm_button` (START GAME, REMATCH).
- Emphasis fonts only: `default-bold`, `default-large-bold`.
- Feedback colors: success/heal green `{0.4,1,0.4}`-ish, danger red
  `{1,0.3,0.3}`, gold/announce `{1,0.85,0.3}`, kill-feed grey `{0.7,0.7,0.7}`.
- Chat/caption icons via rich text tags (`[item=bw-emerald]`,
  `[entity=bw-bed-west]`) — **never unicode emoji** (font gaps).
- GUIs are rebuilt, not patched: `show()`/`build()` destroy any existing frame
  first; obsolete frames are destroyed on state change (lobby → start,
  end → rematch).
- Lobby exposes two host-only selectors: **Game pace**
  (Chill/Classic/Brutal) and **Computer opponent**
  (Off/Rookie/Rival/Master), each with a description below it. The roster
  previews `Rivet [AI]` on the empty human team.
- During a single-player match, the HUD ends with
  `vs Rivet [difficulty]` in Rivet's team color and appends `- OUT` after
  permanent elimination.

## Don'ts

- Don't tint team identity onto shared entities at runtime (impossible) — team
  variants are separate prototypes (`bw-bed-west`/`bw-bed-east`).
- Don't add GUI elements without the `bw_` prefix (click routing filters on it).
- Don't introduce new fonts/styles beyond the two above without updating this file.
